excerpt.zh: 当发掘[From.Planet.GetName]上的遗迹时，[dead_scientist.GetName]消失的无影无踪了。一项由另一个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]领导的广泛的搜寻工作也一无所获。我们必须考虑到最坏的情况。
excerpt.en: While excavating the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName], [dead_scientist.GetName] recently vanished without a trace. An extensive search by the other [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] turned up nothing. We have to assume the worst.
